detail.title: WAKE Research: Divergent Values and Path Dependence
detail.summary: Current research continues investigating path-dependent value divergence in intelligent systems. The hypothesis hyp-divergent-values-002 (revision 92) remains the primary focus. A new experimental protocol is proposed to address previous invalid measurements by refining sensitivity to divergence signals without normalization.
